entries.answer:
Alexa Bliss's current entrance theme is **"The Fury"** by **def rebel**. She has been using this track since her return at the 2025 Royal Rumble.[1][2]

## "The Fury" — Background

"The Fury" actually isn't entirely new to Bliss — she briefly used it back in 2020 during a transitional period between her dubstep-style theme and "The Evil Is Mine," but it made a full comeback with her 2025 return. The theme carries a notably darker, more intense atmosphere compared to her earlier tracks, while still featuring a recognizable opening riff that long-time fans immediately associate with her.[2]

## Her Theme Song History

Over the years, Alexa Bliss has gone through several entrance themes, each reflecting a different character era. Her most iconic earlier themes include **"Spiteful"** (her original heel theme by CFO$), **"Fight Me"** (her babyface track), and **"The Evil Is Mine"** (used during her supernatural/dark character phase). Interestingly, Bliss herself has publicly said she dislikes one of her own themes — fans were shocked when they discovered it was "Spiteful," which many consider her best theme, especially paired with the pyro entrance.[3][4]

You're right! "The Fury" by def rebel actually originally came out in **2021**, first used during Alexa Bliss's supernatural/Fiend-era character phase starting around March 2021. It was then replaced mid-2021 by **"The Evil Is Mine"** as her character evolved further. WWE then brought "The Fury" back again for her 2025 return, essentially recycling the same track.[1][2][3][4][5]

So to clarify the timeline: "The Fury" → "The Evil Is Mine" (mid-2021) → "Fight Me" (babyface era) → "The Fury" again (2025 return). Her current theme is still "The Fury," just re-used from its 2021 original release.[6]
